content: प्रवर {%a.%} .²1 Chief, principal, most excellent or distinguished, best, exalted; भीष्मः कुरूणां प्रवरः <ls>Mb. 3. 85. 116</ls>; संकेतके चिरयति प्रबरो विनोदः <ls>Mk. 3. 3</ls>; <ls>Ms. 10. 27</ls>; <ls>Ghaṭ. 16</ls>. .²2 Eldest. .{@-रः@} A call, summons. .²2 A particular invocation addressed to Agni by a Brāhmaṇa at the consecration of his fire. .²3 A line of ancestors. .²4 A race, family, lineage. .²5 An ancestor. .²6 A Muni or noble ancestor who contributes to the credit of a particular {%gotra%} or family; said to be the friend of Indra; पुरश्चकार प्रवरं वरं यमायन् सखायं ददर्श तया सः <ls>N. 14. 62</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> पञ्च˚, त्रि˚. .²7 Offspring, descendants. .²8 A cover, covering. .²9 An upper garment. .²10 One of the 42 Gotras. .{@-रा@} <ab>N.</ab> of a river falling into the Godāvarī. .{@-रम्@} .²1 Aloe-wood .²2 A particular high number; <ls>Buddh.</ls>
